integrity: The proof is analytic and treats both starting conventions and all parity cases. Exact minimax computation on small profiles is corroborative only. Literature comparison includes the initiating paper, the 2026 general follow-up, the 2026 palette/deletion paper, and the previously recorded K_{1,1,m} special case.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies noncomplete complete split graphs with one non-singleton partite class; it does not classify arbitrary complete multipartite graphs with two or more non-singleton parts.
title: Exact domatic-game numbers of complete split graphs
